scenario_description: Lena has a replacement shelving delivery scheduled for January 14, but the shared loading dock has not been reserved. The prerequisite becomes actionable when the supplier provides the truck size and delivery window needed by the building manager. Proactively contacting the building manager with those details, reserving the dock, recording the reservation alongside the delivery, and informing Greg would protect the delivery from being postponed.

parameter.title: Replacement shelving delivery
parameter.description: Supplier delivery of replacement shelving for Riverbend Market.

parameter.subject: Riverbend shelving delivery booked
parameter.body: The replacement shelving order is booked for Wednesday, January 14, during the 8:00 to 10:00 AM delivery window. Because Riverbend uses a shared loading dock, please arrange dock access before the truck arrives. We will send the truck details separately.

parameter.content: I checked the shared dock calendar and do not see a Riverbend reservation for January 14. To hold the 8:00 to 10:00 window, I need the truck size and the delivery company's name. Please send those details before I can approve access.

parameter.subject: Truck details for January 14 delivery
parameter.body: The shelving will arrive on a 26-foot Northwest Fixtures box truck. The driver needs the full 8:00 to 10:00 AM window to unload. The dock reservation must be confirmed by Monday, January 12, or dispatch may move the delivery to the next available route.

parameter.subject: Dock access cutoff approaching
parameter.body: We still do not have a dock-access confirmation attached to the January 14 shipment. If the reservation is not confirmed by 3:00 PM tomorrow, the truck will be released and the shelving delivery will likely be delayed.

parameter.name: Marta Chen
parameter.notes: Handles reservations for the shared loading dock at Riverbend Market's building.
